summary: Iteration 7 full backend + frontend testing complete. Added 8 new pytest cases in test_iteration7.py covering CheckupInput.ke validation (K3 direct save, duplicate 400, range 1-6/1-4), GET /api/laporan schema & reactivity, and /api/templates CRUD. All 88 pytest tests pass (80 prior + 8 new). UI flows verified: Laporan page renders correctly on /laporan route (regression check for route registration passed), checkup-form-ke selector shows K1-K6 with minggu labels and KF1-KF4 with hari labels, blast modal template save + WA reminder template save are synced via /api/templates and personalize {nama}/{anak}/{jadwal} correctly per patient, template delete removes from both sides.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy test files (test_iteration5.py, test_iteration6.py, test_persalinan_validation.py) use os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL'] without fallback — pytest without the env var breaks collection. Minor DX issue; documented in agent context to export the var. Consider aligning them with backend_test.py pattern which reads /app/frontend/.env via dotenv.
server.py is 858 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting laporan/, templates/, edukasi/ routers into modules.
compute_status: variable `fase` is only defined in the pregnancy branch; when persalinan is set, `fase` is assigned via string literal 'nifas' correctly — no bug, just noting the tight coupling.

Laporan `penyakit` classification is regex-based on free text (hipertensi/DM/lainnya). Simple heuristic could misclassify combos like 'Hipertensi + DM' (assigned to Hipertensi first). Acceptable for MVP but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: Test patients (TEST_iter7_*) and templates (TEST_uisync_*) created during tests are auto-cleaned via fixtures/teardown. No non-TEST data mutated. login_attempts collection not touched (no lockout tests run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q -n 0`. 88 tests total. Iteration 7 added test_iteration7.py with 8 tests. UI regressions all pass: /laporan route registered in App.js, nav-laporan renders laporan-page, checkup-form-ke selector present, blast/WA template sync working via /api/templates.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in iteration 7. Prior /laporan route registration bug fixed and confirmed via UI navigation (URL changes to /laporan and laporan-page testid renders, not falling through to dashboard).
